blurb_zh: 一年里的空气质量起伏
scene_zh: 一座城市的空气质量指数（模拟数据）

views.subject: Air quality index
views.subtitle_en: Monthly average air quality index, January to December.

examples.en: The index reached its lowest point in July, at 38.
examples.zh: 空气质量指数在 7 月降到最低，为 38。

features.note_zh: AQI 数值越低空气越好，用 lowest point 不会误解为“最差”。
features.interpret_zh: 七月最低只是月度均值，不代表当月每天都好，也不说明全年趋势。

examples.en: The index fell steadily from 118 in January to 68 in April.
examples.zh: 指数从 1 月的 118 稳步降到 4 月的 68。

features.note_zh: fall steadily 适合连续多段、每段幅度接近的下降。
features.interpret_zh: 春季下降是季节性走势的一部分，但图里没有供暖或天气数据，不能据此解释原因。

examples.en: The index peaked at 142 in December.
examples.zh: 指数在 12 月达到峰值 142。

features.note_zh: peak at + 数值；主语是 the index 时动词用单数。
features.interpret_zh: 十二月是全年最高月，但这是月均值，单日峰值可能更高。

examples.en: The index rose sharply in November, from 74 to 108.
examples.zh: 指数在 11 月急剧上升，从 74 到 108。

features.note_zh: rose sharply 是中性偏正式说法；口语可说 jumped。
features.interpret_zh: 秋冬上升与供暖季时间接近，但图里没有供暖数据，不能证明因果关系。

examples.en: The summer decline reversed in September, when the index rose from 41 to 52.
examples.zh: 夏季下降在 9 月反转，指数从 41 升到 52。

features.note_zh: turning point 指方向改变；reverse 的主语常是 trend 或 decline。
features.interpret_zh: 转折点只标出变化开始的位置，不解释为什么变。

views.overview_zh: 全年呈 U 形：冬季高、夏季低，7 月 38 最低，12 月 142 最高。3 月到 6 月持续下降，9 月起回升。月度均值掩盖了单日波动，也没有说明污染来源。

general.a2: Air quality was best in July, when the index was 38. It was worst in December, at 142. The index was high in winter, fell through spring, and rose again in autumn.
general.b1: The index fell from 118 in January to 38 in July, then climbed to 142 in December. The cleanest stretch ran from May to August, when monthly values stayed below 56. The autumn increase was steep: the index more than doubled between September and December.
general.b2: The year follows a clear U-shape. The index started at 118, dropped steadily to a July low of 38, and then rose without interruption to 142 in December. The September turning point is sharp: the value climbed from 41 in August to 52 in September and more than doubled by December. Monthly averages smooth out short pollution episodes, so daily peaks are likely higher.

descriptions.ielts: The air quality index was highest in December, at 142, and lowest in July, at 38. It declined steadily from 118 in January to 38 in July before rising sharply over the autumn, more than doubling between September and December.
descriptions.business: The index follows a clear seasonal curve in this sample, with a July low of 38 and a December high of 142. For outdoor events and construction scheduling, the May-to-August window is the safest; the September-to-December climb is where daily checks matter most.

views.subject: Air quality index by area and day
views.subtitle_en: Average air quality index by area and day of the week.

examples.en: The highest cell is Riverside on Friday, at 168.
examples.zh: 最深的格子是河滨区周五，为 168。

features.note_zh: peak_cell 描述网格里最深的格子；具体某天前用 on + 星期。
features.interpret_zh: 这一格只说明它在本网格里最高，不代表全城当天都差。

examples.en: The lightest cell is West Hill on Sunday, at 32.
examples.zh: 最浅的格子是西山周日，为 32。

features.note_zh: 单格描述用 stand at 或 record，句子里仍要给出数值；颜色只是提示。
features.interpret_zh: 最低格说明这个区周日的均值最好，不能推断每天都如此。

examples.en: Riverside is the darkest row every day of the week, averaging 116.
examples.zh: 河滨区一周七天都是最深的一行，均值为 116。

features.note_zh: 行均值用 averaging + 数值；every day of the week 强调没有例外。
features.interpret_zh: 整行都深说明这个区一周都不理想，但网格只含六个区，不能代表全市。

examples.en: Friday averages 101, the highest of any day, but one cell — Riverside at 168 — accounts for most of the lead.
examples.zh: 周五均值 101，是一周里最高的，但主要是被河滨区 168 那一格拉高的。

features.note_zh: 破折号插入语补充说明；account for 在这里指“构成、占”。
features.interpret_zh: 只看列平均会以为全城周五都差；去掉河滨区后，周五与其他工作日接近。

examples.en: Old Town peaks on Friday at 112, well below Riverside's 168.
examples.zh: 老城区周五最高，为 112，仍明显低于河滨区的 168。

features.note_zh: well below 用来比较两个高值；peak 在这里作动词。
features.interpret_zh: 同一天不同区差距很大，看全城平均会掩盖这种分布不均。

views.overview_zh: 网格有两个明显结构：河滨区整周最深，周五 168 是全图峰值；西山整周最浅，周日 32 是全图最低。周五列均值最高，但主要来自河滨区一格，提醒看列均值时要回到单元格。

general.a2: Riverside has the highest values every day, and its Friday cell reaches 168. West Hill is the cleanest area all week, with a Sunday low of 32. The other four areas sit in between.
general.b1: Riverside is the darkest row across all seven days, averaging 116, while West Hill is the lightest at 49. Friday is the darkest column, but that is mostly because of Riverside's 168; the other areas are close to their Thursday values. Sunday is the cleanest day overall.
general.b2: Two gradients dominate the grid. Riverside is the darkest area on every day, peaking at 168 on Friday, while West Hill is consistently the lightest, bottoming out at 32 on Sunday. The Friday column average of 101 looks alarming, but removing Riverside's cell brings it back in line with Thursday, so the column summary hides a single-area spike.

descriptions.ielts: Riverside recorded the highest values on every day of the week, reaching 168 on Friday, whereas West Hill was consistently the lowest, at 32 on Sunday. Friday had the highest column average at 101, followed by Saturday at 90 and Thursday at 88.
descriptions.business: Air quality is uneven across the city: Riverside runs roughly twice the level of West Hill on average, and its Friday spike of 168 is the week's outlier. Friday's column average is misleading on its own — five of six areas are within 8 points of their Thursday readings, so any response should target Riverside rather than the whole city.
